words.meaning: 那時；當時；然後（此處指時間）
words.note: 使用者提供。then 是 at that time 最核心、最精簡的近義詞，表示在剛提到的某個時間點或時期。它非常常見，既可指過去，也可指未來語境中的某個既定時間。
words.example: I was living in Bristol then.

exercises.original: In 2018, she was working in Manchester. At that time, she had not yet started her own company.

words.meaning: 在那段期間；在那一時期

words.example: During that period, the company expanded into three new markets.

words.meaning: 在那些日子；在那個年代；當年
words.note: in those days 指較久以前的一段生活時期或年代，通常帶回憶、歷史背景或今昔對比。它比 back then 更有 period/era flavour，也不適合精確單一時間點。
words.example: In those days, most records were kept on paper.

falseSynonyms.zh: then 是最精簡的回指，可指過去或未來；at that time 更完整、更明示時間。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON We lived in Bristol then. At that time, I was still a student.

falseSynonyms.word: at that time / during that period
falseSynonyms.zh: during that period 必須是一段時期；單一瞬間或決策點不適合。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON During that period, sales rose steadily. At that time, the manager made a decision.

falseSynonyms.word: at that time / at the time
falseSynonyms.zh: 兩者高度接近；at the time 更慣用於『按當時所知／情況』來解釋過去決定。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON At the time, we did not know the cost. At that time, the office was still in Leeds.

falseSynonyms.zh: back then 較口語，只指過去，常與 today/now 形成對比；不能正常指未來。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Back then, few people had smartphones. We will meet again in June; at that time, we will decide.

falseSynonyms.word: at that time / at that point
falseSynonyms.zh: at that point 強調流程或敘事中的具體節點；at that time 不一定有 sequence meaning。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON At that point, we changed direction. At that time, I lived nearby.

falseSynonyms.word: at that time / at that stage
falseSynonyms.zh: at that stage 強調 development/process phase；普通日曆時間不一定能用。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON At that stage, the design was incomplete. At that time, she was living abroad.

falseSynonyms.word: at that time / in those days
falseSynonyms.zh: in those days 指過去一段年代／生活時期，常描述習慣與普遍情況；不適合單一時間點。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON In those days, people wrote more letters. At that time, the train arrived.

falseSynonyms.zh: meanwhile 表示『與此同時』，連接兩件同期發生的事；它不是單純回指某個時間。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Meanwhile, the second team continued testing. At that time, no decision had been made.
